title: Claims Payments Computation: Cardinal Rental Reimbursement Rideshare Reimbursement Amount
content:
**Computation.** Under Cardinal Rental Reimbursement, rideshare, taxi and transit fares are reimbursed for the claim's most recent rideshare authorization. That is the latest authorization on the claim whose provider is recorded as rideshare, taxi or transit.

1. **Covered rideshare days.** These run from the start date of the rideshare authorization through the end date of its closing, both days included.
2. **Daily amount.** Each covered rideshare day is paid at the option's daily limit.
3. **Reimbursement.** The covered rideshare days multiplied by that daily amount. The reimbursement is never above what the per-loss maximum still allows, which is the option's per-loss maximum less the agency payments and reimbursements on the claim, net of agency credits. It is never below zero, and it is rounded to the cent.

## Worked computation (hypothetical figures, Cardinal Rental Reimbursement 30/900)

| Item | Figure |
|---|---|
| Rideshare authorization start date | July 2 |
| End date of its closing | July 6 |
| Covered rideshare days, both ends included | 5 |
| Daily amount (the option's daily limit) | $30.00 |
| Covered days multiplied by the daily amount | $150.00 |
| Per-loss maximum of $900.00 less $800.00 already paid on the claim | $100.00 |
| Reimbursement | $100.00 |

With nothing yet paid on the claim, the same rideshare authorization would be reimbursed $150.00.
